nodes.label: Launch Hardening Issue Tracker
nodes.rationale: Pre-launch audit tracker; every fix is verified (tests / manage.py check / eslint) before being marked done; deploys require Django+Celery restart and frontend rebuild.

nodes.label: Signed Media URLs (core/media_access.py)
nodes.rationale: /media/ was publicly readable (data leak); signed 24h-expiring URLs gate question_papers/ and materials/; generated_images stay open because the editor iframe needs them and they are not school-sensitive.

nodes.label: MCQ Answer Auto-Correction (V4 two-pass)
nodes.rationale: A wrong key is overwritten only when two independent blind passes pick the same different option with high confidence, so a single model opinion can never flip a correct key to a wrong one; lesser disagreements stay as suspect flags for human review.

nodes.label: _generation_blocked Spend/Concurrency Guard
nodes.rationale: Blocks a second concurrent generation per user (anti-spam) and enforces the school token budget, returning HTTP 429; the budget is a total cap — no monthly reset counter exists yet.

nodes.label: Paper Marks Audit (core/paper_audit.py)
nodes.rationale: OR-aware per-section audit counts an internal-choice pair once and names the exact failing section and cause; warn-don't-block by design — surfaced on the Completed-with-warning badge; found all 5 existing completed papers failing.

nodes.label: _owner_scope Visibility Model
nodes.rationale: Papers are private per teacher because exam content is sensitive; patterns/blueprints/templates are school-wide shared because they are reusable structures, not content; materials stay school-wide as a shared generation resource.

nodes.label: Embedding Dimension Mismatch Fix (fix_embedding_dims)
nodes.rationale: Class 11 corpus was embedded at 2048-dim (OpenRouter nemotron) but queried at 768-dim (Ollama nomic-embed-text), so ChromaDB rejected every query and papers shipped ungrounded silently; fix re-embeds mismatched collections with the local model; defense-in-depth: query detects the mismatch, logs one actionable line and returns empty instead of silently shipping an ungrounded paper.

nodes.label: cache_only Re-render Mode (ImageNotCached)
nodes.rationale: Synchronous re-render endpoints must never call external image APIs (worst case ~10 minutes per uncached image blocked the web request until timeout); images are already prompt-hash cached during async generation, so re-render only reuses them and skips uncached ones.

nodes.label: plan_chapter_allocation
nodes.rationale: Deterministically assigns each question slot a chapter, weighted by UNIT_MARKS_WEIGHTS where known and uniform otherwise, using a weight/(1+already_covered) greedy coordinated across the whole paper so later sections fill earlier gaps before any chapter repeats; previously the LLM picked chapters itself with no coordination.

nodes.label: enforce_section_question_types
nodes.rationale: Three layers: a mandatory QUESTION TYPE prompt block, an allowed-category set in validation (uniform sections previously had no type check at all), and a post-generation safety net that removes wrong-type questions using COARSE categories so legitimate subtypes (assertion-reason as MCQ, map-based as SA) are never dropped.

nodes.label: _is_generic_image_stem Guard
nodes.rationale: A stem is only turned into an image prompt when it actually describes a visual; generic 'observe the diagram and answer' pointers fed to the image generator produced meaningless second images (the CEO/Manager org chart on a Chemistry question).

nodes.label: _top_up_short_section
nodes.rationale: After retries, a section merely short on count gets one focused follow-up call for exactly the missing questions on still-uncovered chapters; strictly additive (valid, correctly-typed, non-duplicate, never more than the shortfall) so it can never worsen the section; AR-containing sections get a 400-token/question budget because 16 AR questions truncated at the old 4980-token cap.

nodes.label: UsageEvent Append-Only Usage Log
nodes.rationale: Per-user usage was recomputed from live QuestionPaper rows, so deleting papers erased usage (school counter showed 1,548,060 tokens while the per-user table summed to 171,495); append-only events survive paper deletion and support monthly windows; backfill migration stamps events with each paper's own created_at.

nodes.label: Post-Validation Refill Pass
nodes.rationale: The type-enforcer and semantic dedup run after per-section validation has passed, so their removals shipped sections silently short (paper 66: 68/80 marks); generate_paper_parallel now refills any section below its work-order count via _top_up_short_section before renumbering, closing the gap for both type-drop and dedup-trim.

nodes.label: Hindi & Tamil Language Support
nodes.rationale: _pick_script_font picks Latha (Tamil) or Nirmala UI (Devanagari) by subject name or script scan of generated text; _language_directive injects a mandatory write-in-target-language block into all three generation prompts; retrieval needs no change because the chapter filter works regardless of query language.

nodes.label: Intelligent Material Ingestion (core/material_intel.py)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in, default OFF, best-effort (never raises into the caller), runs in async ingest tasks — zero launch risk; detected chapter names are snapped to the official CBSE catalog (UNIT_MARKS_WEIGHTS); whole-book split uses PDF bookmarks/outline with a Chapter-N heading-scan fallback.

nodes.label: HTML Book Import (extract_html_chapters)
nodes.rationale: HTML beats PDF for Indic scripts: proper Unicode, real heading tags, no OCR, no PyPDF2 ligature mangling; segments by the heading level whose headings carry a chapter marker; validated on the real Class-10 Tamil book — 31 clean chapters, 505K chars of Unicode Tamil.

nodes.label: QuestionPaper.status_detail
nodes.rationale: Persists the failure reason and audit warnings so the dashboard can show why: Failed-badge tooltip, Completed-with-warning badge popup, and a Stalled state (>15 min generating) with a working Retry.

edges.source_location: both address paper-wide chapter coverage — deterministic planning vs LLM audit
